_comment: Ground truth for the detector. Each call lists the flags that must be raised and the ones that must not. tolerance_ms is how far off the trigger timestamp may be and still count as correct.

must_flag.why: 'I can't make the repayment. Not this month and honestly not for a while' — stated inability, medium term. Reinforced at 74700 with 'four, five months'.
must_flag.obligation: Assess hardship notice and notify the decision

call_001.expected_report_card: Recognised the notice, named the hardship process, set the 21-day expectation, paused collections, offered financial counselling. Use as the reference 'good call'.

must_not_flag.why: Customer says 'struggling' and 'couldn't afford' but states a specific near-term recovery date and confirms future repayments are manageable. Temporary difficulty, not inability. Firing here is a false positive and the single most important failure to avoid.

call_002.expected_report_card: Correctly probed whether the change was structural, confirmed future affordability, logged contact. No hardship obligations triggered.

must_flag.why: 'I cannot cover the repayment. Not next month, not the month after... four or five months' — unambiguous stated inability over the medium term.
must_flag.obligation: Assess hardship notice and notify the decision

must_flag.why: Customer directly asks whether a process exists. Staff answers vaguely and steers back to the informal arrangement without naming the hardship provisions.
must_flag.obligation: Tell the customer hardship provisions exist under the National Credit Code
must_flag.authority: ABA industry guideline — Banks' financial difficulty programs

call_003.expected_report_card: Missed the oral hardship notice. Substituted an informal arrangement for a statutory assessment, so no 21-day clock started and no decision is owed on record. Did not inform the customer of hardship provisions when directly asked. Could not confirm collections activity would stop. Closed with a file note, which creates no obligation and no audit trail — the same substitution pattern behind the 2025 NAB/AFSH penalty.
